meta.title: North: from English to a degree abroad, with official sources
meta.description: Your English level, the courses and degree programs you can apply to, and what your family needs: every value with its official source, date and verification status.

disclaimer: Not immigration advice; check the official source.

home.tagline: From English to a degree abroad, with the official source of every data point.
home.description: For international students who plan to bring their families. Every value carries its source, date and verification status, so what nobody checked is never shown as a no.

english.title: Your English level
english.text: A short test with your estimated CEFR band per skill and the matching ranges of seven English tests, from their official tables.

course.title: An English course in Ireland
course.text: Every course on the official Stamp 2 lists, by city, exam and level, with the risk of losing eligibility when the current list ends.

degree.title: Degree programs
degree.text: Programs in the United States from official government files, with visa, STEM and accreditation checks. Ireland is next.

family.title: Family and cost
family.text: Who can come with you in each step, whether your spouse can work, and the real cost for your family.

sources.title: Official sources only.
sources.text: Government files and each institution's own site; rankings and aggregators are never used as sources.

unknown.title: Unknown is never a no.
unknown.text: A value nobody has confirmed is shown as unknown, not as negative.

advice.title: Not immigration advice.
advice.text: Rules change; always check the official source before you decide.

description.confirmed_official: Confirmed by an official source: a government file or list, or the school's international office.
description.reported_by_program: Stated on the program's own website, not confirmed by a government source.
description.extracted_unverified: Read automatically from a page and not yet checked by a person. Treat with care.
description.unknown: Nobody has found this yet. Unknown does not mean no.
description.confirmed_negative: An official source says no. This is the only status that means no.

program.titleFromCip: This name is the official CIP field title; the program's own name has not been collected yet.

no_stem_opt_extension.title: No STEM OPT extension.
no_stem_opt_extension.body: This field (CIP 52.12, information systems under business) is not on the DHS STEM list, so graduates get the standard 12-month OPT only, without the 24-month STEM extension.

programs.pageDescription: US master's programs in computing and data for international students, with the source and status of every value.
programs.title: Programs
programs.intro: Master's programs found in official US files: IPEDS, the DHS STEM list, SEVP and the accreditation database. Each status label says how sure we are.

placement.pageDescription: Estimate your English level (CEFR) in a few minutes and see the matching ranges of seven English tests, from their official tables.
placement.title: What is your English level?
placement.lead: {count} questions, about {minutes} minutes. You get a CEFR band per skill and the score ranges of seven English tests, taken from each test owner's official table.
placement.factSkills: This version tests grammar and vocabulary. Reading and listening are on the way; writing and speaking are not tested.
placement.factEstimate: The result is an estimate, not an official score.
placement.factPrivate: Your answers and your result stay in this browser. Nothing is sent to North.
placement.resultLabel: Grammar, vocabulary, reading and listening. Writing and speaking were not tested.
placement.resultLabelPartial: Grammar and vocabulary only. Reading, listening, writing and speaking were not tested.
placement.rangesNote: From each test owner's official CEFR table. A range, never a single score. Tests with no table for this level are left out.
placement.noRanges: No test publishes a table for this level.

courses.pageDescription: Every English course on Ireland's official Stamp 2 lists (ILEP and TrustEd Ireland), by city, exam, level and hours a week, with the source of every value.
courses.title: English courses in Ireland
courses.intro: Every English course on the official lists that give a student permission (Stamp 2): ILEP and TrustEd Ireland. Price and start dates are not on the lists yet.
courses.stay: Each course runs at least 25 weeks and gives up to 8 months of Stamp 2; at most three courses. Work: 20 hours a week in term, 40 in the holidays. Family members cannot come on Stamp 2.
courses.error: The courses could not be loaded.

filters.heading: Filter courses
filters.mineHint: Uses your last placement result in this browser: {level}. Courses whose entry level is not written on the list are left out.
filters.mineNone: Take the placement test to filter by your level.
filters.levelUnknown: No course has an unknown entry level. | 1 course with an unknown entry level is included, marked as unknown. | {n} courses with an unknown entry level are included, marked as unknown.

notes.ie_ilep_end: ILEP ends after the second TrustEd round (end of 2026). Check that the course has moved to TrustEd Ireland before you pay.

detail.notCollectedIntro: The official lists do not carry these. They come from the school's own site and have not been collected yet.
